title: Fallen Drop (26.3 remake)
description: This mod adds most of the features from the minecraft live where they announced the 26.3 drop. (Adds turkeys as well)
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/rCwDpanmEMU" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Adds Almost every feature from minecraft live. This mod adds:

New Poplar Wood set and Leaves.
Turkey Entities (My addition).
Raw and cooked versions of the turkey.
Dappled Forest biome (and a cool red biome fog).
Leaf litters.
Shelf Mushrooms.
Wool Stairs and slabs.
Abandoned Camp Structure.

Almost all block textures used in this project are downloaded from the Minecraft Wiki.
Original assets and concepts belong to Mojang Studios.

THIS REQUIRES:
Geckolib 1.20.1
Terrablender 1.20.1
Biome modifier for fabric 1.20.1
Fabric api 1.20.1
